extracted_parameters.quote: An FDM printer (Felix 3.0, Felix robotics, the Netherlands) used for the fabrication of the flow cell.

extracted_parameters.value: A multi-material 3D printer with dual nozzles
extracted_parameters.quote: A multi-material 3D printer with dual nozzles allowed printing of the device body with an opaque material, black PLA, and the transparent detection window, transparent PLA.
The extruder temperature was 210 °C, the print bed was 70 °C.
The extruder temperature was 210 °C, the print bed was 70 °C.

Therefore, to print the transparent part of the flow cell, a layer thickness of 150 μm was chosen to provide a relatively smooth surface because of the presence of fewer number of layers and therefore fewer grooves.
The printing speed was kept at 50 mm/sec.

extracted_parameters.value: parallel to the slit i.e. XY direction
extracted_parameters.quote: Based on our previous work on printing orientation optimisation for the fabrication of slit for photometric detection assembly [ 4 ], the printing direction was kept parallel to the slit i.e. XY direction.
